description: Scott will fight to rebuild union power in America and make sure bold action on housing, climate, and public transit means good union jobs and that the workers who build our roads, homes, and infrastructure have fair pay and rights. In Congress, he'll support the PRO Act to help millions of new workers organize, take on companies that use AI to spy on and harm workers, and make Washington finally take the side of workers over corporations.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Scott Wiener for Congress
title: Labor Policy
